s.how: Fry 3 rashers bacon and 1 onion, add 2 potatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer. Add 400g clams and 200ml cream and cook 5 minutes.
Bake 1.2kg wings tossed in baking powder and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in hot sauce and butter and serve with ranch. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Roast a 1.5kg beef topside at 200C for 1 hour. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Make gravy from the pan juices with 300ml stock. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: a Boston classic for a Boston film
w.how: Bake a 20cm sponge and split. Fill with 400ml thick custard and top with 100g chocolate melted with 80ml cream. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Pour 4 pints of cold lager. Cranberry juice for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
